name: year
description: Year of the sitting day
observations: Partition column. Derived from the sitting date

name: date
description: Date of the sitting day on which the utterance was made

name: chamber
description: Chamber in which the utterance was made
observations: Two values: House of Representatives, Senate. Stored as readable labels rather than codes

name: parliament_number
description: Ordinal number of the Parliament in session
observations: Stored as STRING because it labels a Parliament rather than measuring a quantity; arithmetic on it is meaningless

name: session_number
description: Ordinal number of the session within the Parliament

name: period_number
description: Ordinal number of the sitting period within the session

name: speech_order
description: Sequential position of the utterance within the sitting day
observations: Sequence number, counted from 1 in document order. Stored as STRING because it is a position label, not a quantity

name: speaker_id
description: Identifier assigned by the Parliament to the speaker
observations: Not yet linked to a directory. An Australian person directory is planned; until it exists this is an unresolved identifier. Identifier schemes differ by era: alphabetic codes before 1998, numeric codes in recent years, and the same person may carry more than one

name: talk_type
description: Kind of utterance
observations: speech is an opening turn, interjection is an interruption by another member, continuation is the original speaker resuming after an interjection

name: debate_type
description: Category of business assigned to the debate by Hansard
observations: Free-text category from the source; values are not standardised across eras

name: debate_title
description: Title of the debate under which the utterance was recorded

name: subdebate_title
description: Title of the subdebate under which the utterance was recorded
observations: Null when the utterance sits directly under a debate with no subdebate

name: speaker_name
description: Name of the speaker as recorded in the transcript
observations: Formatting varies by era: Mr MACDONALD-PATERSON in early transcripts, surname-first in recent ones. Not normalised

name: electorate
description: Electorate or state the speaker represents
observations: For members of the House this is a division; for senators a state or territory. The source states it only on a member's opening turn, so it is completed across that member's other turns within the same sitting day from the source's own value (see observations on party). Around 81% filled in 1901 and 93% in 2001; near 40% for 1981-1997, where interjections carry neither an identifier nor a matching name form

name: party
description: Political party of the speaker
observations: Recorded inconsistently. The source states party on a member's opening turn and leaves it blank on that member's interjections and continuations, so it is completed within a sitting day from the value the source itself gives for the same speaker_id (or, where the era gives no id, the same exact speaker_name). This is completion, not imputation: party cannot change within a sitting day. Names are never matched loosely, since that would attribute one member's party to another. Some historic transcripts store a career party history rather than the affiliation held on the day

name: role
description: Parliamentary or ministerial office held by the speaker
observations: Populated mainly for 1901-1997; largely absent from recent transcripts, where office appears inside the body text instead. Completed within a sitting day on the same basis as party

name: in_government
description: Whether the speaker belonged to the governing party at the time
observations: Boolean stored as a 0/1 code so that blanks in the source stay distinguishable from a genuine No

name: first_speech
description: Whether the utterance is the speaker's first speech to the chamber
observations: Boolean stored as a 0/1 code. Not populated for 1981-1997, where the source has no equivalent field

name: time_stamp
description: Clock time at which the utterance began
observations: HH:MM, 24-hour. Taken from the source field where present, otherwise recovered from the time prefix in the body text. Absent from transcripts before 1981, which did not record times

name: page_number
description: Page of the printed Hansard on which the utterance begins
observations: Stored as STRING because it is a page label, not a quantity

name: body
description: Full text of the utterance
observations: Verbatim transcript text with whitespace collapsed. Recent transcripts embed a speaker and time prefix at the start of the text, for example Mr ALBANESE (Grayndler-Prime Minister) (09:32):

name: word_count
description: Number of whitespace-separated tokens in the utterance text
observations: Derived, not from the source. Counts tokens rather than dictionary words
